ordered.generator: SciPy scrambled Sobol, d=42, first 16 valid non-overlapping starts
ordered.definition: Exact regular triangles at r/R=0.45 and 0.63, zero velocities; independent global/relative orientation, z-centers sampled from {0, ±0.1, ±0.25}R.
ordered.phase_sampling: two independent uniform phases in [0,2π), fixed per run
ordered.physical_overlap_filter: reject only if any center distance <= sum of the prescribed finite radii; rejected candidates are counted in metadata before dynamics
ordered.protocol: P2_505, identical for every initial condition; continuous carriers

perturbed.generator: SciPy scrambled Sobol, d=42, first 16 valid non-overlapping starts
perturbed.definition: Same triangle scaffold with independent radial offsets ±0.025R, Gaussian angular offsets σ=5 degrees, z offsets ±0.025R, zero velocities.
perturbed.phase_sampling: two independent uniform phases in [0,2π), fixed per run
perturbed.physical_overlap_filter: reject only if any center distance <= sum of the prescribed finite radii; rejected candidates are counted in metadata before dynamics
perturbed.protocol: P2_505, identical for every initial condition; continuous carriers

random_azimuth.generator: SciPy scrambled Sobol, d=42, first 16 valid non-overlapping starts
random_azimuth.definition: Three particles per group on r/R=0.45 and 0.63 with independent uniform azimuths, z-centers from {0, ±0.1, ±0.25}R, zero velocities.
random_azimuth.phase_sampling: two independent uniform phases in [0,2π), fixed per run
random_azimuth.physical_overlap_filter: reject only if any center distance <= sum of the prescribed finite radii; rejected candidates are counted in metadata before dynamics
random_azimuth.protocol: P2_505, identical for every initial condition; continuous carriers

random_position_rest.generator: SciPy scrambled Sobol, d=42, first 16 valid non-overlapping starts
random_position_rest.definition: All six independently uniform in area over 0.03≤r/R≤0.90 and uniform in −0.5≤z/R≤0.5; zero velocities.

random_position_rest.physical_overlap_filter: reject only if any center distance <= sum of the prescribed finite radii; rejected candidates are counted in metadata before dynamics
random_position_rest.protocol: P2_505, identical for every initial condition; continuous carriers
